annotations.grafana.app/message: Explicit grid layout: metrics in thirds, log tables full width

spec.title: Pizzas
spec.description: Pizzas sold per minute, creation failures per minute, and revenue per minute.

spec.title: HTTP Request Logs
spec.description: Method, path, status code, authorization flag, authenticated user, request and response bodies.

spec.title: Log Events per Minute by Type
spec.description: Volume of each required log category: http, db, factory, exception.

spec.title: Database Query Logs
spec.description: Every SQL statement run by the service, with the authenticated user. Parameters are masked for statements touching credential columns.

spec.title: Factory Service Logs
spec.description: Calls to pizza-factory.cs329.click with the requesting user and both request and response bodies.

spec.title: Unhandled Exceptions
spec.description: Errors reaching the Express default error handler, with message and stack trace.

spec.title: CPU and Memory Usage
spec.description: Host CPU load and memory consumption of the service container.

spec.title: HTTP Requests per Minute by Method
spec.description: Total incoming requests and the breakdown by HTTP verb.

spec.title: Latency
spec.description: Average service endpoint latency and pizza creation latency at the factory.

spec.title: Active Users
spec.description: Users currently holding a valid session (logins minus logouts).
